task: Reconcile Living Roadmap v2 maturity backbone after the accepted Managed Template Quick Start insertion so dependency order and architecture-health proof remain canonical.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Main commit 5f74a0f1 legitimately inserted MANAGED-TEMPLATE-QUICK-START into the canonical maturity backbone, but left BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE without a dependency on the new predecessor and left architecture-health proof hard-coded to the previous nine-element backbone, causing exact-head main Quality Tests to fail.
observableOutcomes: Living Roadmap v2 contains the accepted MANAGED-TEMPLATE-QUICK-START in the maturity backbone between TEMPLATE-CAPABILITY-CENSUS-42 and BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE.
BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE explicitly depends on MANAGED-TEMPLATE-QUICK-START while retaining its existing dependencies.
architecture-health regression asserts the ten-element canonical backbone and verifies every adjacent maturity dependency.
Exact-head CI returns green without weakening any architecture, roadmap, quality or release gate.
unresolvedRisks: The roadmap item was added concurrently after Unit 2 merge; the hotfix must not alter Unit 2 code or reopen its closed lifecycle.
Changing only the test would mask a real dependency gap, while removing the roadmap item would discard an accepted product decision.

in: Reconcile the new maturity-backbone dependency edge.
Update the canonical regression proof to the accepted ten-element backbone.
Restore exact-head main quality without touching Unit 2 implementation.
out: No Release Risk, Completion Truth, Sentinel, Template Factory or Control Plane gate changes.
No change to the content or semantics of the accepted Managed Template Quick Start capability.
No Builder, storefront, auth, commerce or runtime implementation changes.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is a bounded canonical-roadmap dependency reconciliation with no runtime behavior change, but it affects architecture authority and must preserve explicit dependency semantics.

acceptanceCriteria: The new roadmap node remains present and accepted.
The architecture-health test expects the ten-element backbone in the same order as the roadmap.
The adjacency loop proves the new edge rather than merely accepting the longer array.
Full Quality Tests, TypeScript and Production Build pass on exact head.
invariants: Living Roadmap v2 remains the only roadmap authority.
Higher-layer maturity cannot silently bypass a newly inserted lower-layer prerequisite.
Tests follow accepted canonical roadmap truth; tests are not weakened to accept arbitrary order.
Unit 2 release-decomposition code and closed lifecycle remain unchanged.

failureModes: The new backbone entry is accepted in data but the next maturity item does not depend on it.
The regression list stays stale and reports a false architecture drift.
Only the regression is changed, allowing an actual dependency gap to survive.
edgeCases: BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE already has multiple dependencies; the new predecessor must be additive, not destructive.
Future backbone assertions must continue to fail if order or dependency continuity changes.

alternatives.reason: The item is an accepted canonical product decision and its scope is internally coherent.
The adjacency proof would expose the missing BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE dependency; hiding that would weaken the authority.

alternatives.summary: Add the missing dependency and update the proof together.
alternatives.reason: This restores consistency between authority data and executable regression without changing product semantics.

specialistReviews.finding: The new roadmap node is structurally valid but insertion into a canonical maturity chain requires the successor edge.
specialistReviews.resolution: Make BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE depend on MANAGED-TEMPLATE-QUICK-START and prove adjacency.

specialistReviews.finding: The red main is caused by an unrelated post-merge roadmap commit, not Unit 2.
specialistReviews.resolution: Repair in a separate bounded transaction from current main.

specialistReviews.finding: A new managed no-Builder launch mode could be treated as optional UX and therefore excluded from the hard maturity backbone.
specialistReviews.resolution: The roadmap itself marks it P0 and stage-4-before-builder-production-complete, and its scope says ordinary launch must work without Visual Builder on the same canonical runtime. Therefore Builder production maturity may not bypass it.

challenge.scenario: Only update the expected test array to ten items.
challenge.finding: The next adjacency check would correctly fail because BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE lacks the new predecessor.
challenge.resolution: Repair the roadmap dependency first-class and update proof in the same transaction.

challenge.scenario: Remove the new backbone item to restore the previous test.
challenge.finding: That would silently discard accepted managed-template launch sequencing.
challenge.resolution: Preserve the accepted item and reconcile the chain.

challenge.scenario: The new roadmap node is inserted into the backbone and the successor dependency is added, but another existing BUILDER-PRODUCTION-COMPLETE dependency is accidentally removed during reconciliation.
challenge.finding: A narrowly targeted edge fix can still regress independent prerequisite authority if it replaces rather than augments the dependency list.
challenge.resolution: Make the dependency update additive and keep existing VISUAL-BUILDER, GUARDED-VISUAL-SECTION-LIBRARY and TEMPLATE-CAPABILITY-CENSUS-42 prerequisites; regression proof continues to validate the maturity predecessor separately.

proofPlan: Require exact-head Plan Before Code PASS on this plan-only commit before implementation.
Assert the roadmap backbone has exactly the accepted ten ordered elements.
Run full architecture-health and Quality Tests.
Require exact-head Completion Truth/Lifecycle according to the canonical gate chain before merge.

requirements.requirement: The accepted Managed Template Quick Start is integrated as a true maturity prerequisite, and executable architecture proof matches the canonical ten-element backbone.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A maturity-backbone node must not be inserted without making its successor depend on it.

notes: Separate recovery transaction for the unrelated roadmap commit that landed after Unit 2 was merged. Unit 2 remains closed and untouched. Plan-only CI 37478243393 reconciled exact canonical scope: DOMAIN-QUALITY; authority quality-knowledge-system; subsystems builder-template-system, customer-account, dependency-contract, payment-checkout-order-authority, shared-storefront; Negative Knowledge and assurance requirements updated exactly from Plan Before Code diagnostics.
